OK.name: Oklahoma

notice.text: Give notice at least 48 hours (not the notice day, weekends or holidays) before digging: a Monday notice can be dug Thursday.

life.text: A notice expires 14 calendar days from the start date. The app counts from the first legal dig day.

OK.renew: Update the ticket (Extend, or Re-Mark if marks are gone) at least 4 business days before it expires. Each adds 14 days.
OK.tol_text: 2 feet either side of the line. Hand dig only until the line is exposed. Machines may remove pavement only.
OK.white_text: White-line the dig area before you call.

SC.name: South Carolina

notice.text: Operators have 3 full working days to mark, not counting the call day: a Monday call can be dug Friday. SC811’s holidays (Confederate Memorial Day, Christmas Eve, the day after Christmas) don’t count.

life.text: A normal ticket is good for 15 working days from its start time.

start.text: Call no more than 10 full business days before work starts.
